fields.operationsPersonnel: OSC: T. Reyes. Branch Director: S. Mills. Group Supervisor: L. Chen
fields.workAssignments: Deploy 600 ft of deflection boom at the Heron Bay creek mouth in a J configuration, open side down-current. Anchor every 100 ft. Inspect and tend boom at slack tide. Report boom position to the Situation Unit every two hours.
fields.specialInstructions: Do not enter the nesting area without a wildlife team escort. Wear PFDs on all boats. Stop work and return on any lightning within 10 miles. Collect oily waste in labeled bags and carry it out.
fields.communications: Tactical: Channel 12. Wildlife: Channel 14. Branch Director cell: 555-0142. Command: Channel 10.
